record.task: The coil-loss follow-up of ad3-rlc-pilot: why the ideal series RLC model fails on the pilot's circuit (G1, G2 of the frozen registration)
record.hypothesis: Each registered rule returns the outcome its explanation predicts, or inconclusive; the follow-up decides which
assumptions: The pilot's sweeps are read through the dataset's reader unchanged, at the 13 coarse frequencies; the nominal 100 ohm stands for R_s_bb until M4.
The thresholds were chosen after seeing the pilot's data: the pilot's numbers are exploratory, only M1 to M5 are confirmatory.
The simulated controls use the closed form of the series circuit with the pilot's own noise level, the registered input, and fixed seeds.
The follow-up's outcomes are computed only from a session measured after the freeze, by the code whose identity the log records.

split.probed: the pilot's two sweeps (exploratory) and the simulated controls
split.held out: M0 to M5 of the registration, made after part 2 is merged

claims.text: Exploratory: the pilot's R-L node sweep, read with the nominal 100 ohm, gives R_L0 near the resonance and a loss that rises towards 200 kHz; these data chose the thresholds and confirm nothing
claims.scope: pilot run 3 of ad3-rlc-pilot (2026-11-22), the nominal resistor

claims.text: Exploratory: an assumed channel mismatch at the registration's thresholds changes Rise by tens of ohm, so the pilot cannot separate a mismatch from a loss that depends on the frequency (G2 needs M3)
claims.scope: pilot runs 2 and 3, constant assumed mismatches

claims.text: Each rule returns the outcome its explanation predicts on simulated sessions (DC, AC, MISMATCH, BOTH; the precondition met and not met; G1 undecidable under a steep loss), for every seed
claims.scope: simulated sessions at the pilot's noise level, seeds 0, 1, 2, 3, 4

claims.text: At every threshold the rules give the outcome the registration's text gives at that value, never two at once; the meter model behaves as registered on constructed readings
G1 (the loss near the resonance): inconclusive
claims.scope: the pilot's circuit of F140 on the owner's breadboard, as measured with the AD3 (the parts, the breadboard, the leads, and the instrument together)

claims.text: G2 (the frequency dependence and the phase residual): inconclusive
